decisive_items: A provisional diagnosis of prostatic sarcoma was made
The biopsy result was interpreted as either prostatic stromal sarcoma or prostatic stromal tumor of uncertain malignant potential
Positron emission tomography–CT and colonoscopy suggested rectal invasion
response.rationale: The clinical picture of a large invasive prostatic mass with bladder and rectal involvement and a provisional diagnosis of sarcoma favors prostatic stromal sarcoma, but the biopsy explicitly leaves the uncertain-malignant-potential entity as an alternative, so confidence is limited.

rejected.why: It is the less aggressive/uncertain counterpart and is less consistent with the invasive features and provisional sarcoma diagnosis, though the biopsy ambiguity prevents full exclusion.
